articles.title: Microwave Frying Slashes Oil in French Fries — Without Ruining the Crunch
articles.summary: Frying with microwaves could make fries healthier by cutting oil absorption. Researchers found that microwaves create internal pressure that blocks oil from seeping in, cooking fries faster while keeping them crispy. The technique uses a specialized fryer and could change how your favorite snack is made.

articles.title: Five Evolutionary Secrets That Made Prehistoric Sharks Colossal
articles.summary: Megalodon and other giant sharks didn't just happen by chance. Paleontologists identify five key factors — from avoiding pliosaurs to cannibalizing siblings in the womb — that allowed predatory sharks to exceed 50 feet. Their rise was tied to abundant blubbery prey and the ability to cross oceans.

articles.title: Spider Diagrams Unlock Quantum Teleportation for High Schoolers
articles.summary: A UK workshop proved that 16-year-olds can master quantum teleportation using a pictorial calculus. Instead of equations, students manipulated 'spider' diagrams that are mathematically equivalent to Hilbert space formalism. The approach demystified quantum theory and sparked enthusiasm, with one student presenting the protocol to the class.
